About Blog Etc Projects

Hello there.

I’m Micaela, a Brazilian/Portuguese engineer living in the Netherlands, where I’m finishing my master’s in Business Informatics and interning as a Product Manager at Elsevier.

Before, I worked as a Product Strategist at Huge, where I helped reknown brands reach business goals by rethinking their digital experience. I’m also a skilled data analyst and I love to photograph on my free time.

I get energized by…

  • …automating things for other people around me.
  • …uncovering user needs after a round of interviews.
  • …discussing candidate solutions for a business problem.
  • …finding data sources for answering a question.
  • …learning about a new API or spreadsheet integration.
  • …sharing references and interesting reads with others.
